info.title: kiapi Embedding API
info.description:
Text and multimodal embeddings for retrieval and similarity search.

`POST /v1/embeddings` follows OpenAI's embeddings API: `input` is a string or an
array, and each input returns one L2-normalized, last-token-pooled vector in
`data`. Multimodal models also accept `{text, image}` objects in `input`, a kiapi
extension. Sync only (no async mode).

## Upstream docs
- [mlx-embeddings](https://github.com/Blaizzy/mlx-embeddings) — the MLX embedding engine kiapi runs
- [mlx-community/Qwen3-Embedding-8B-mxfp8](https://huggingface.co/mlx-community/Qwen3-Embedding-8B-mxfp8) — `qwen3-embedding-8b` weights
- [mlx-community/Qwen3-VL-Embedding-2B-mxfp8](https://huggingface.co/mlx-community/Qwen3-VL-Embedding-2B-mxfp8) — `qwen3-vl-embedding-2b` weights

## Choosing A Model
`model` selects a registered embedding model (full catalog and aliases:
`GET /v1/embedding/models`). The served models differ by input modality, so
choose by what you send:
- **qwen3-embedding-8b** (default) — text only. Larger, stronger text retrieval.
- **qwen3-vl-embedding-2b** — text + image. Use it for image embeddings or a
  shared text/image space; sending `image` to the text-only model returns 400.

Vectors from different models live in different spaces and may differ in
dimensionality — embed both your queries and your corpus with the **same** model.

## Notes
- `input` accepts up to 2048 items. Items run one at a time.
- Inputs longer than the token limit return 400; they are never truncated.
- Empty inputs return 400. Token arrays are not accepted.
- `dimensions` truncates the vector and L2-normalizes it again.
- `usage` counts text tokens; images are not counted.
- Vectors are already L2-normalized, so cosine similarity reduces to a dot
  product.
- `GET /v1/models` lists chat models only. Use `GET /v1/embedding/models` here.

## Examples

### Text (default model)
```sh
curl -sS http://HOST:PORT/v1/embeddings \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"input": "今日の天気は晴れです"}'
```

### Image (multimodal model)
```sh
curl -sS http://HOST:PORT/v1/embeddings \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{
    "model": "qwen3-vl-embedding-2b",
    "input": [{"image": "data:image/png;base64,iVBORw0..."}]
  }'
```

post.description:
Create embeddings, following OpenAI's embeddings API.

`input` takes a string or an array, and `data` returns one L2-normalized,
last-token-pooled vector per input. Multimodal models also accept
`{text, image}` objects. The resolved `model` (see GET /v1/embedding/models)
determines which modalities are accepted.

Embedding runs as a single-flight job, so it appears in /v1/jobs and is
serialized with all other generation, but there is no async mode: the caller
always waits for the vectors. A wait that exceeds the sync timeout returns 504
while the job keeps running and can be polled at /v1/jobs/{id}.

400.description: Unknown model, empty or oversized input, unsupported modality, or unsupported dimensions.

503.description: Model not set up, or memory budget exceeded.

504.description: Sync timeout exceeded; the job keeps running.

get.description:
List the servable models for this capability.

Returns the public catalog of every variant selectable via the ``model``
field on this capability's endpoints.

schema.title: Response List Models V1 Embedding Models Get

name.title: Name
name.description: Model variant name to pass in the request model field.

family.title: Family
family.description: Capability family that resolves this model variant.

domain.title: Domain
domain.description: Capability domain used for grouping model lists.

aliases.title: Aliases
aliases.description: Alternative names that also resolve to this model.

default.title: Default
default.description: Whether this is the default model when the request omits model.

features.title: Features
features.description: Handler-declared modalities and features supported by this model.

CapabilityModelSpec.title: CapabilityModelSpec
CapabilityModelSpec.description: Public model discovery entry for capability-specific model lists.

image.title: Image
image.description: Image to embed, as a base64 string, data URL, or http(s) URL. Only multimodal models accept it.

EmbedItem.title: EmbedItem
EmbedItem.description: One input with a field per modality (kiapi extension to OpenAI's `input`).

model.title: Model
model.description: Registry name, alias, or repo of the embedding model (see `GET /v1/embedding/models`). Omit to use the default model.

input.title: Input
input.description: Text to embed, an array of inputs, or an `{text, image}` object for multimodal models. Each array element returns one embedding. Token arrays are not accepted.

dimensions.title: Dimensions
dimensions.description: Output vector length. The vector is truncated and L2-normalized again. Supported: 32-4096 for `qwen3-embedding-8b`, 64-2048 for `qwen3-vl-embedding-2b`.

encoding_format.title: Encoding format
encoding_format.description: `float` returns a number array; `base64` returns little-endian float32 bytes.

data.title: Data
data.description: One embedding per input, in order.

model.title: Model
model.description: Resolved model name that produced the vectors.

index.title: Index
index.description: Position of the input in the request.

embedding.title: Embedding
embedding.description: L2-normalized, last-token-pooled vector: a number array, or base64 when `encoding_format` is `base64`.

prompt_tokens.title: Prompt Tokens
prompt_tokens.description: Text tokens in the inputs. Images are not counted.

total_tokens.title: Total Tokens
total_tokens.description: Total tokens accounted for; equals `prompt_tokens` (no generation).
